subject: English
question_text: Make five sentences using parts of sentences from each column of the table below.
stimulus: went to the battlefield to save the country Our War of Independence did not run place in 1971 People from all walks of life fought face to face with the enemies They took away showing their backs joined the war
guide_solution: Producing sentences from a substitution table: (i) Our War of Independence took place in 1971. (ii) People from all walks of life joined the war. (iii) They went to the battlefield to save the country. (iv) They did not run away showing their backs. (v) They fought face to face with their enemies.
